page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number 104 to its left; no margin notes; catchword "vestra" at the lower right.

main_text.p: Quandoquidem etiam verendum est, ne scintilla illa dissidii, quod jam exoritur inter Duces Casimirum & Virtenbergicum, propter tutelam junioris Electoris Palatini, & administrationem Electoratus, magni incendii flammam excitet, quam citra omnem dubitationem Sathan, Antichristus Romanus, eorumque asseclæ, magis ac magis accendere conabuntur, in perniciem Germaniæ, Serenit. Maj. vestra opus dignum erit, ut ita initia dissensionum inter istos duos Principes maturè extinguantur, ut mutua animorum consensio inter eos coalescat.

Præterea quum Regis Hispaniæ & Guisianorum artibus quædam discordiæ excitantur inter Reginam Angliæ & Scotorum Regem, ex quibus exoriri tandem posset, non sine magno discrimine totius Europæ, gravissimum bellum, plurimum orbis Christiani interest, si Ser. Maj. vestra

page.notes: Ligatures and italic display words are approximated; the words "vestra" at the foot repeat as the catchword. Some words in the first lines are blurred. Mid-page "Serenit." may be a misreading of "Seren."; marked as printed in the scan.
